title: danny-avila/LibreChat
title_zh: 增强版 ChatGPT 克隆体：LibreChat v0.8.8-rc3

paragraphs.en: Enhanced ChatGPT Clone: Features Agents, MCP, Skills, DeepSeek, Anthropic, AWS, OpenAI, Responses API, Azure, Groq, o1, GPT-5, Mistral, OpenRouter, Vertex AI, Gemini, Artifacts, AI model switching, message search, Code Interpreter, langchain, DALL-E-3, OpenAPI Actions, Functions, Secure Multi-User Auth, Presets, open-source for self-hosting. Active
paragraphs.zh: 增强版 ChatGPT 克隆：功能包括智能体、MCP、Skills、DeepSeek、Anthropic、AWS、OpenAI、Responses API、Azure、Groq、o1、GPT-5、Mistral、OpenRouter、Vertex AI、Gemini、Artifacts、AI 模型切换、消息搜索、Code Interpreter、langchain、DALL-E-3、OpenAPI Actions、Functions、安全的多用户身份验证、预设，以及支持自托管的开源方案。活跃

paragraphs.en: 🖥️ UI & Experience inspired by ChatGPT with enhanced design and features
paragraphs.zh: 🖥️ 受 ChatGPT 启发的 UI 与体验，并具有增强的设计与功能

paragraphs.en: For a thorough review of our features, see our docs here 📚
paragraphs.zh: 如需全面了解我们的功能，请参阅此处的文档 📚

paragraphs.en: LibreChat is a self-hosted AI chat platform that unifies all major AI providers in a single, privacy-focused interface.
paragraphs.zh: LibreChat 是一个自托管的 AI 聊天平台，它将所有主流 AI 提供商统一在一个注重隐私的界面中。

paragraphs.en: Beyond chat, LibreChat provides AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, Artifacts, Code Interpreter, custom actions, conversation search, and enterprise-ready multi-user authentication.
paragraphs.zh: 除了聊天功能外，LibreChat 还提供 AI 智能体、模型上下文协议（MCP）支持、Artifacts、代码解释器、自定义操作、对话搜索，以及面向企业的多用户身份验证。

paragraphs.en: Open source, actively developed, and built for anyone who values control over their AI infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 开源、积极开发中，并为所有重视 AI 基础设施控制权的人而构建。

paragraphs.en: Keep up with the latest updates by visiting the releases page and notes:
paragraphs.zh: 请访问发布页面和发布说明以了解最新更新：

paragraphs.en: ⚠️ Please consult the changelog for breaking changes before updating.
paragraphs.zh: ⚠️ 请在更新前查阅变更日志以了解破坏性更改。

paragraphs.en: Contributions, suggestions, bug reports and fixes are welcome!
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎贡献、提出建议、报告错误和提交修复！

paragraphs.en: For new features, components, or extensions, please open an issue and discuss before sending a PR.
paragraphs.zh: 对于新功能、组件或扩展，请在发送 PR 之前先开一个 issue 进行讨论。

paragraphs.en: If you'd like to help translate LibreChat into your language, we'd love your contribution! Improving our translations not only makes LibreChat more accessible to users around the world but also enhances the overall user experience. Please check out our Translation Guide .
paragraphs.zh: 如果您想帮助将 LibreChat 翻译成您的语言，我们非常欢迎您的贡献！ 改进我们的翻译不仅能让世界各地更多用户更方便地使用 LibreChat，还能提升整体用户体验。 请查看我们的翻译指南。
